Bisect from the post-merge runs: the last green run is on `7868d3786` (21:50Z). The first red run is on `6eff704f2` (22:15Z). Between them on main there is exactly one merge, **PR #3496** (`fix(multiaxis)`, rotary zigzag seam rings, #3168). It changes `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_zigzag.rs`, `crates/motion/src/machining3d/hsm.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs`.

Every run since then (`44e6a`, `79d47`, `074c2`, `c4462`, `d0327`, `f480d`, `8f5da`, `f6716`, `18c43`, `3c68d`) fails only `app rotary_verify::a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius`. So this is a single regression, not flakiness. The PR's quick gate would not run `app rotary_verify`: the change is in `camcraft-motion`, and that suite sits under app.

The failure output (the assertion) is in the runs' `gate-logs` artifact. That test pins where a rotary rough starts on a bar larger than the part. Until the assertion is read, the failure may be an entry into uncut stock (P1 by the table) rather than a red gate only (P2).
